newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates stay high in short market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates stay high in short market.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates remained high on Friday due to a shortage of funds, dealers said.
The day started at 19.90 and 20 percent and borrowers took no chances, with most trades struck at about 20 percent, one dealer of KASB & Co said.
Rates dipped when some funds changed hands at 19 and 18.50 percent, but bounced back to early levels and the market closed at about 20 percent, the dealer said.
